verdict.rationale: Jan's API reference documents a POST /v1/messages endpoint described as Anthropic-compatible, with automatic request translation so Anthropic SDK clients can point at the local server, plus curl examples and sample responses. The docs also mention connecting Jan with Claude Code, which fits this endpoint. Missing for 10: documented detail on streaming and tool-use parity for the messages endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Anthropic SDK clients work against it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint

citations.quote: Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint. Jan automatically translates requests to the internal format, so you can use Anthropic SDK clients pointed at your local server
